faqs.a:
(a)
Pay rate increases within an established pay grade may be granted to an employee based
               on an employee's performance. An employee will first be considered for a pay increase
               upon satisfactory completion of the required employment probationary period.
Thereafter, employees may be considered for additional pay increases upon either the
               satisfactory completion of each 12 subsequent months of service, or upon a date established
               by the city manager as the annual pay increase review date until the employee reaches
               the maximum rate of the pay grade. All pay increases will be submitted to the director
               of human resources or a designee for review. No pay increase may be granted in excess
               of the maximum rate for the pay grade.
(b)
In instances where an employee is denied a pay increase based on performance, the
               employee's supervisor or appointing authority will inform the employee in writing
               of the areas in which the employee needs performance improvement. The performance
               of an employee who is denied a pay rate increase may be reviewed again at a time determined
               by the appointing authority.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
